title: Yum Brands earnings beat estimates, but cyclospora outbreak weighs on Taco Bell
summary: Yum Brands reported earnings that exceeded expectations, yet the company faced challenges due to a Cyclospora outbreak linked to lettuce served at Taco Bell locations. This health issue adversely affected customer traffic, leading to a decline in same-store sales for the fast-food chain. Despite the positive earnings report, the outbreak highlights the ongoing risks associated with food safety in the restaurant industry.
